## Suggest a mod source

Add your repo to `sources.json`. Checklist:

- [ ] The repo is public and has a `dist/` folder with `manifest.json` plus the `.dll`/`.pdb` files (made by `publish.ps1`, see `template/README.md`)
- [ ] Every mod has a unique `Guid` and does not use the name of an existing mod
- [ ] I will keep it free of malware, spyware and anything that touches files outside the game folder
- [ ] The entry has a short `name` and one line `about` that says what the mods do
